scenes.text: Watch and read: Ama asks: A class sings a song about kindness. What does its message encourage?
The answer is: help one another. Explain the message of a song using the words and actions.
Watch and read: Ama asks: What does this rhyme mean: “Rain, rain, help seeds grow”?
The answer is: Rain helps plants grow. Explain a rhyme in simple, everyday words.
